name: everworld-ai
description: Browser-based sandbox for persistent societies of autonomous AI characters

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @everworld/engine && concurrently -n engine,server,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @everworld/engine" "npm run dev -w @everworld/server" "npm run dev -w @everworld/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @everworld/engine && npm run build -w @everworld/server && npm run build -w @everworld/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @everworld/engine && npm run test -w @everworld/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @everworld/engine && npm run typecheck -w @everworld/server && npm run typecheck -w @everworld/web
